card.title: Lessons for Travelers
card.passage: Many people enjoy traveling to other countries. However, they sometimes worry about speaking foreign languages. Now, some companies offer short online lessons for travelers. Travelers take such lessons before their trips, and by doing so they can learn useful phrases for airports and hotels quickly.

steps.t: First, please read the passage silently for 20 seconds.
All right. Now, please read it aloud.
Now, I'll ask you five questions.
Number 1. According to the passage, how can travelers learn useful phrases for airports and hotels quickly?
Number 2. Now, please look at the people in Picture A. They are doing different things. Tell me as much as you can about what they are doing.
Number 3. Now, look at the woman in Picture B. Please describe the situation.
Now, please turn over the card and put it down.
Number 4. Do you think more people will take online lessons in the future?

points: However, / Now, のあとで少し区切る
by doing so を自然につなげる

q1.q: According to the passage, how can travelers learn useful phrases for airports and hotels quickly?
q1.ja: 旅行者は、どうすれば空港やホテルで役立つ表現を早く学べますか。
model: By taking such lessons before their trips.
They take short online lessons before their trips.
points: by doing so の doing so が指す内容を答える
such lessons → short online lessons と言いかえてもOK

q2.q: Tell me as much as you can about what they are doing.
q2.ja: (イラストA)人々がしていることを、できるだけたくさん説明してください。
model: A man is reading a newspaper. A girl is drinking juice. A woman is carrying a box. A boy is riding a bicycle. A man is talking on the phone.
points: carry a box / ride a bicycle / talk on the phone

q3.ja: (イラストB)女性の状況を説明してください。
model: She wants to take a picture of the mountain, but she can't because it's cloudy.
points: 吹き出しの「したいこと」+ できない理由
wants to ～, but she can't because ～

q4.q: Do you think more people will take online lessons in the future?
q4.ja: 将来、オンラインレッスンを受ける人は増えると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → People can take lessons at home. They don't need to go to a school, so it saves time.
model.no: No. → Many people want to talk with teachers face to face. They can learn better in a classroom.

card.title: Reusable Bottles
card.passage: Many people buy drinks in plastic bottles every day. However, plastic bottles can cause problems for the environment. Now, some stores let customers fill their own bottles with water for free. People carry such bottles with them, and by doing so they can reduce plastic waste.

steps.t: First, please read the passage silently for 20 seconds.
All right. Now, please read it aloud.
Now, I'll ask you five questions.
Number 1. According to the passage, how can people reduce plastic waste?
Number 2. Now, please look at the people in Picture A. They are doing different things. Tell me as much as you can about what they are doing.
Number 3. Now, look at the boy in Picture B. Please describe the situation.
Now, please turn over the card and put it down.
Number 4. Do you think more people will carry their own bottles in the future?

points: However, / Now, のあとで区切る

q1.q: According to the passage, how can people reduce plastic waste?
q1.ja: どうすれば人々はプラスチックごみを減らせますか。
model: By carrying their own bottles with them.
They carry their own bottles with them.
points: by doing so の前の内容

q2.q: Tell me as much as you can about what they are doing.
q2.ja: (イラストA)人々がしていることを、できるだけたくさん説明してください。
model: A girl is eating ice cream. A man is playing the guitar. A woman is walking her dog. A boy is kicking a ball. An old man is taking a picture.
points: walk a dog / kick a ball

q3.ja: (イラストB)男の子の状況を説明してください。
model: He wants to drink some water, but he can't because the water fountain is out of order.
points: したいこと(吹き出し)+ できない理由(看板)

q4.q: Do you think more people will carry their own bottles in the future?
q4.ja: 将来、自分のボトルを持ち歩く人は増えると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Many people are interested in the environment. Also, they can save money by not buying drinks.
model.no: No. → Carrying a bottle is not convenient. Many people don't want to carry heavy things.

card.title: Volunteer Guides
card.passage: Many foreign tourists visit Japan every year. However, it is sometimes difficult for them to find their way around big stations. Now, some students work as volunteer guides at stations. They help tourists in English, and in this way they can also practice speaking English.

steps.t: First, please read the passage silently for 20 seconds.
All right. Now, please read it aloud.
Now, I'll ask you five questions.
Number 1. According to the passage, how can some students practice speaking English?
Number 2. Now, please look at the people in Picture A. They are doing different things. Tell me as much as you can about what they are doing.
Number 3. Now, look at the woman in Picture B. Please describe the situation.
Now, please turn over the card and put it down.
Number 4. Do you think more students should do volunteer work?

points: in this way を自然につなげる

q1.q: According to the passage, how can some students practice speaking English?
q1.ja: 一部の生徒たちはどうやって英語を話す練習ができますか。
model: By helping tourists in English at stations.
They work as volunteer guides and help tourists in English.
points: in this way の前の内容

q2.q: Tell me as much as you can about what they are doing.
q2.ja: (イラストA)人々がしていることを、できるだけたくさん説明してください。
model: A woman is looking at a map. A man is carrying a suitcase. A girl is drinking juice. An old man is reading a newspaper. A boy is using his smartphone.
points: look at a map / carry a suitcase

q3.ja: (イラストB)女性の状況を説明してください。
model: She wants to buy a ticket, but she can't because the ticket office is closed.
points: したいこと + できない理由

q4.q: Do you think more students should do volunteer work?
q4.ja: もっと多くの生徒がボランティア活動をするべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Students can learn many things by helping other people. It is also a good experience for their future.
model.no: No. → Students are busy with studying and club activities. They need time to rest.

card.title: School Gardens
card.passage: Some schools have gardens where students grow vegetables. Students take care of the plants every day. Now, some schools use these vegetables in school lunches. Students eat the vegetables they grow, and by doing so they can learn how important food is.

steps.t: First, please read the passage silently for 20 seconds.
All right. Now, please read it aloud.
Now, I'll ask you five questions.
Number 1. According to the passage, how can students learn how important food is?
Number 2. Now, please look at the people in Picture A. They are doing different things. Tell me as much as you can about what they are doing.
Number 3. Now, look at the girl in Picture B. Please describe the situation.
Now, please turn over the card and put it down.
Number 4. Do you think schools should teach students how to cook?

points: how important food is を最後まではっきり

q1.q: According to the passage, how can students learn how important food is?
q1.ja: どうすれば生徒たちは食べ物の大切さを学べますか。
model: By eating the vegetables they grow.
They eat the vegetables they grow.
points: by doing so の前の内容
they grow までを1つのまとまりで

q2.q: Tell me as much as you can about what they are doing.
q2.ja: (イラストA)人々がしていることを、できるだけたくさん説明してください。
model: A woman is carrying a basket. A boy is flying a kite. A girl is eating a rice ball. A man is painting a picture. Another man is reading a book.
points: fly a kite / paint a picture
2人目の男性は Another man で

q3.ja: (イラストB)女の子の状況を説明してください。
model: She wants to work in the garden, but she can't because it's raining.
points: したいこと + できない理由(天気)

q4.q: Do you think schools should teach students how to cook?
q4.ja: 学校は生徒に料理の仕方を教えるべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Cooking is a useful skill for life. Students can also learn about healthy food.
model.no: No. → Students can learn cooking at home. Schools should spend more time on other subjects.

card.title: Museum Apps
card.passage: Museums have many interesting things to see. However, visitors sometimes do not know much about the things they are looking at. Now, some museums have apps for smartphones. Visitors listen to explanations on the apps, and by doing so they can enjoy the museums more.

steps.t: First, please read the passage silently for 20 seconds.
All right. Now, please read it aloud.
Now, I'll ask you five questions.
Number 1. According to the passage, how can visitors enjoy the museums more?
Number 2. Now, please look at the people in Picture A. They are doing different things. Tell me as much as you can about what they are doing.
Number 3. Now, look at the man in Picture B. Please describe the situation.
Now, please turn over the card and put it down.
Number 4. Do you think museums should be free for students?

points: they are looking at を1つのまとまりで

q1.q: According to the passage, how can visitors enjoy the museums more?
q1.ja: どうすれば来館者は博物館をもっと楽しめますか。
model: By listening to explanations on the apps.
They listen to explanations on the apps.
points: by doing so の前の内容

q2.q: Tell me as much as you can about what they are doing.
q2.ja: (イラストA)人々がしていることを、できるだけたくさん説明してください。
model: A man is taking a picture. A girl is listening to music. Another man is drinking coffee. A woman is writing in a notebook. A boy is sitting on a chair.
points: listen to music / write in a notebook

q3.ja: (イラストB)男性の状況を説明してください。
model: He wants to take a picture of the painting, but he can't because taking photos is not allowed.
points: したいこと + できない理由(看板)
is not allowed=禁止されている

q4.q: Do you think museums should be free for students?
q4.ja: 博物館は学生には無料にするべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Students can learn a lot at museums. If museums are free, more young people will visit them.
model.no: No. → Museums need money to take care of their collections. Students can pay a small price.

ekp2_5.q: These days, many people enjoy camping. Do you like to go camping?
ekp2_5.ja: キャンプに行くのは好きですか。

model.yes: Yes. → I like cooking outside with my family. Last summer, we went camping near a lake.
model.no: No. → I don't like insects. I prefer staying in a hotel.

points: Yes なら具体的な経験を

ekp2_5.q: Many students join club activities at school. Are you in a club at school?
ekp2_5.ja: 学校で部活に入っていますか。

model.yes: Yes. → I am in the tennis club. We practice every day after school.
model.no: No. → I want to use my time for studying. I also go to a cram school.

points: Yes ならどんな部か・どのくらい

ekp2_5.q: Many people enjoy watching sports on TV. Do you like watching sports?
ekp2_5.ja: スポーツを見るのは好きですか。

model.yes: Yes. → I like watching baseball games. My favorite team is the Tigers.
model.no: No. → I prefer playing sports to watching them. It's more exciting.

points: Yes ならどのスポーツか

ekp2_5.q: Some people keep a diary. Do you keep a diary?
ekp2_5.ja: 日記をつけていますか。

model.yes: Yes. → I write a diary in English every night. It is good practice for me.
model.no: No. → I'm too busy in the evening. I take pictures instead.

points: Yes ならいつ・どんなふうに

ekp2_5.q: Many people like going to the beach in summer. Do you often go to the beach?
ekp2_5.ja: 夏によく海に行きますか。

model.yes: Yes. → I go to the beach with my friends every summer. We swim and play volleyball.
model.no: No. → There is no beach near my house. I usually go to the pool.

points: Yes ならだれと・何をする

ekp2_5.q: These days, many people take pictures with their smartphones. Do you often take pictures?
ekp2_5.ja: よく写真を撮りますか。

model.yes: Yes. → I like taking pictures of airplanes. I often go to the airport to take them.
model.no: No. → I don't have a smartphone yet. I want to enjoy things with my own eyes.

ekp2_5.q: Some students like to study at cafes. Do you like studying outside your home?
ekp2_5.ja: 家の外で勉強するのは好きですか。

model.yes: Yes. → I often study at the library. I can concentrate there.
model.no: No. → It is noisy outside. I can study better in my room.

points: Yes ならどこで・なぜ

ekp2_5.q: Many people enjoy cooking at home. Do you often cook for your family?
ekp2_5.ja: 家族のためによく料理をしますか。

model.yes: Yes. → I make breakfast on weekends. My family likes my omelets.
model.no: No. → My mother is a good cook. I usually help her wash the dishes.

ekp2_5.q: These days, many people use bicycles to get around. Do you often ride a bicycle?
ekp2_5.ja: よく自転車に乗りますか。

model.yes: Yes. → I ride my bicycle to school every day. On weekends, I ride along the river.
model.no: No. → My house is on a hill. I usually take the bus.

points: Yes ならいつ・どこへ

ekp2_5.q: Some people like to travel abroad. Do you want to visit a foreign country?
ekp2_5.ja: 外国に行ってみたいですか。

model.yes: Yes. → I want to visit the United States. I want to see a big air show there.
model.no: No. → There are still many places I want to visit in Japan.

points: Yes ならどこへ・何をしに
